routeSales.title: Route sales · today
routeSales.subtitle: Salesmen on their beats: GPS check-ins at each shop, orders, collections and cash handovers · for the sales manager and Admin
routeSales.noRight: Route sales needs the sales manager's rights. Ask Admin.
routeSales.noSalesmenBody: Admin gives the salesman role on Users; beats are planned below.
routeSales.outside: Outside the shop's check-in area: needs the sales manager's OK

beat.title: Beat plan
beat.body: Each salesman has fixed beats by weekday; the sales manager moves a shop to another day or salesman.

gps.title: GPS check-in
gps.body: A visit counts only within the distance Admin sets around the shop's saved pin (150 m unless changed); further away needs the manager's OK, never the salesman's own.

visit.title: Every visit ends with something
visit.body: An order, a collection, a follow-up, or "no order" with a reason.

orders.title: Orders from the price list
orders.body: Prices come from the customer's price list and cannot go above MRP; a credit order over the limit waits for approval.

cash.title: Cash handed over daily
cash.body: Collections are counted by note and handed to the cashier, who counts again on their own login; a difference goes to the Bug fixer. Cash of ₹2 lakh or more from one customer in a day is refused.

privacy.title: Location only on duty
privacy.body: Tracking runs from start of day to day end after the salesman accepts the written notice, points are kept 90 days, and nothing is recorded off duty (DPDP Act).

routeSales.noSalesmanRole: No one has the salesman role

ho.title: Cash handovers
ho.noneBody: Salesmen hand over cash from End day on their phone.
ho.countHelp: Count the notes yourself without looking at the salesman's count. If your count, his count and the cash collected all agree, the cash moves to your cash account; otherwise it is flagged for finance.
ho.blind: The salesman cannot confirm his own handover; the server checks it.
ho.resolveHelp: The cashier's count goes into the cash account; the difference stays on the salesman's cash account until settled.

beat.title: Beats
beat.noneBody: Plan a beat: a salesman, a weekday and the shops in visit order.
beat.planHelp: The shops on the beat are assigned to its salesman. Tick them in visit order.

assign.title: Customer, salesman and price list
assign.help: Assign a customer to a salesman (he then sees only his own customers) and set the price list his orders use. Salesmen cannot change prices.
